about_the_game:
SUPERSWEEP is a sleek and modern reimagining of the classic Minesweeper, rebuilt with intense visuals, satisfying chain reactions, and ultra-challenging grids. This is logic at its most dangerous one wrong move, and it's game over...

SUPERSWEEP pushes your skills to the limit with larger grid sizes or smaller for beginners, and customizable modes, including 3 secret modes! Every step matters.

Whether you’re easing into logic puzzles or ready to challenge your memory and deduction, SUPERSWEEP delivers gameplay that’s both meditative and high-stakes. Every tile is a mystery. Every cleared zone is earned.

Flag bombs, clear safe spaces, and watch massive sections of the board reveal themselves in animated bursts. With glowing visuals, a moody atmosphere, and smooth transitions, this isn't just a puzzle it's a experience!

Features:

  • Classic tile-based logic gameplay with no guessing and no RNG traps.

  • Chain-reaction reveals that explode across the board when you uncover safe zones.

  • Difficulty scaling from beginner boards to massive 49×49 sweeper gauntlets.

  • Minimalist, glowing aesthetic with crisp sound design for a clean, immersive feel.

  • Multiple difficulties, hidden challenges, and [REDACTED] secrets to unlock.

Whether you're a veteran Minesweeper strategist or a curious newcomer, SUPERSWEEP offers a rewarding test of logic, memory, and guts.

Will you step up onto the plate? Or will you blow it?

  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11
  • Processor: Dual-core Intel or AMD processor, 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics (Intel HD 4000 or equivalent)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM

  • DirectX: Version 12
